scope: graph-4 same-page continuation, event relations and migrations 023/024, notifications, creator products and frontend contracts
verification: Two targeted reproductions against isolated localhost boothhana_release_test; both transactions rolled back. No external push sent. Full test suite not rerun in this review.

findings.problem: Each same-page SALES window becomes a separate legacy stage. CatalogService constructs all product checks using only IDs seen in the current window. The final window therefore marks earlier approved products NOT_RECONFIRMED and publishes the incorrect verification status.
findings.reproduction: ReviewSalesBatch.java: approve 100 + 3 goods from one unchanged 103-item page. SALES_BATCH_STATE=COMPLETE; both stored and public checks have NOT_RECONFIRMED=100 and CONFIRMED_CURRENT=3; ROLLED_BACK=true.
findings.recommendation: Carry confirmed product IDs through the verified page-batch chain and retain their current verification during subsequent windows. Verify the final public snapshot, not just row count.

findings.problem: Registering an existing push endpoint with the same owner and keys cancels all PENDING/SENDING deliveries. The frontend reuses an existing PushSubscription, so an already-open second settings tab can trigger this. The subscription stays active, but canceled notifications are never requeued.
findings.motivatingCode: update subculture_push_delivery set state='CANCELED',lease_token=null,lease_until=null where subscription_id in(select id from subculture_push_subscription where endpoint=?) and state in ('PENDING','SENDING')
findings.reproduction: ReviewPushRegistration.java and review-push-registration.log: BEFORE_SAME_OWNER_REGISTER=PENDING; AFTER_SAME_OWNER_REGISTER=CANCELED; SUBSCRIPTION_STILL_ACTIVE=true; ROLLED_BACK=true.
findings.recommendation: Make same-owner, same-key registration idempotent; cancel former-owner deliveries when endpoint ownership changes.
